events.title: CHOICE
events.summary: Some choices in the game affect what happens in the demo, while others will matter later.There aren’t too many branches yet, but we plan to add more consequences as development continues.What did you choose in these requests?

events.title: SOME GIRLS
events.summary: Every now and then, the King will have the chance to meet several women and choose who he wants to spend more time with.There’s one scene like this in the demo, when the King steps outside for some fresh air.We’d like to do more scenes like this in the future. What do you think?

events.title: MEET HILDEGARD
events.summary: Hildegard runs the royal household and makes sure everything in the castle stays in order.She’s proper, disciplined, and can be strict — especially with herself.Did you like Hildegard? What would you like to see from her in the future?

events.title: MEET MARION
events.summary: Marion is a farmer’s daughter you can meet if you make choices in favor of the people and their festivals.She’s a simple village girl, and spending time with her can be a lot of fun.Did you like Marion? What would you like to see from her in the future?

events.title: MEET RAGNA
events.summary: Ragna is the captain of a Durnian mercenary company. You’ll meet her during the military route, where she offers the King her soldiers — for a price.What do you think of her so far? And what would you like to see from Ragna in the future?

events.title: YOUR THOUGHTS?
events.summary: The demo has been out for a few days now. What did you think?Tell us what you liked, what you didn’t, and what you’d like to see next.

events.title: The Royal Yes — Speedpaint Process
events.summary: We've noticed some questions about how the artwork for The Royal Yes is created, so we thought it would be a good opportunity to share a little behind-the-scenes look at our drawing process.Since we hadn't been saving any work-in-progress before, our artist went the extra mile and recreated the entire illustration from scratch, using their original artwork as a reference, just so we could share the drawing process with you! From now on, we'll make sure to record and save more of it.https://anonm

events.title: THE DEMO IS OUT!
events.summary: The demo of The Royal Yes is now available.The demo gives you the first decade of the King’s reign, with court decisions, political problems, and a few women to meet along the way. This is only the beginning, and we already have a lot more planned for the game.Play the demo and let us know what you think!

events.title: THE GIRLS
events.summary: A sneak peek at some of the women you’ll meet in the demo.All three are very different, and all three need your attention.Not a bad day to become king.

events.title: THE COURT
events.summary: Meet some of the people you’ll see at court.The demo is coming October 8.

events.summary: 📢 IMPORTANT ANNOUNCEMENT 🚨 All Hentai and Furry fans, get ready!Horny Capybara, in collaboration with Furlough Games and Sei-ren, is organizing the first festival where the Hentai and Furry genres will go head-to-head ⚔️ Players can look forward to a wide selection of games, as well as the chance to influence the outcome.
